a: Reggie James is a UK-based technology business builder and go-to-market adviser with 25 years in technology markets. He is the founder and managing director of Digital Clarity and COO and Executive Director of Digital Brand Media & Marketing Group, Inc. (OTC: DBMM). He is based in Guildford, Surrey, and London.

He works with founders, CEOs and investors in technology, software and financial-services businesses on go-to-market strategy, proposition and positioning, brand, business development and applied AI. He starts with customer conversations and market data, agrees where to focus, and stays involved through delivery.

Reggie James founded Digital Clarity in 2002. He built it to a team of 25 to 30 people working with more than 200 clients, including Adobe, Xerox and Bentley Systems, and moved it from search and performance marketing into strategic growth and go-to-market advisory.

DC Storm was a marketing measurement platform that Reggie James built within Digital Clarity to measure performance across fragmented digital channels. Around 48% of major media planning and buying agencies used it before it was acquired by Rakuten.

q: What is Reggie James's role at DBMM Group?
a: Since 2011 he has been COO, Senior Vice President and Executive Director of Digital Brand Media & Marketing Group, Inc., a US public company quoted as OTC: DBMM. Digital Clarity is its wholly owned operating business.

q: Does Reggie James have a podcast?
a: Yes. Reggie James - Perspectives has more than 50 episodes of conversations on B2B marketing, go-to-market and growth, available on Spotify, Apple Podcasts and at reggiejamespodcast.com.
